headline: These 5 REITs Have Made Their Investors Very Rich
summary: Real estate investment trusts (REITs) have historically performed very well. Overall, REITs have outperformed the S&P 500 in 15 of the last 25 years, generating an annualized total return of 10.9% during that period. The five best over the last decade have been Equinix (NASDAQ: EQIX), First Industrial Realty (NYSE: FR), Extra Space Storage (NYSE: EXR), SBA Communications (NYSE: SBAC), and Sun Communities (NYSE: SUI).
